biotools.summary: e3SIM is an open-source, agent-based simulator designed to model infectious disease dynamics by explicitly integrating epidemiological, ecological, and evolutionary processes (epi-eco-evo). It allows for realistic simulations of pathogen spread, mutation, and environmental factors in diverse host-pathogen systems.
biotools.name: e3SIM: Epidemiological-ecological-evolutionary simulation framework for genomic epidemiology
